prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-clean, minimalist, high-fashion editorial portrait series of a generic adult man, not a recognizable real-person likeness. Arrange three cinematic frames vertically with generous negative space, precise alignment, thin white separators, and a seamless neutral-white studio backdrop. Top frame: centered downward gaze with relaxed shoulders. Middle frame: crisp symmetrical frontal portrait with balanced facial alignment. Bottom frame: three-quarter semi-profile with a restrained confident expression. He wears an unbranded black athletic crew-neck top with narrow light shoulder stripes. Use soft diffused key light, subtle fill, and a delicate rim light. Shoot on a high-end full-frame mirrorless camera with an 85mm f/1.4 lens, natural skin texture, a refined black-and-white tonal curve, and premium editorial polish. No logo or text.
